svg.text: a new block wants to tip inward; the staple holds it
face view: a steel clip drops into slots cut in both blocks
The robot fits it after placing the block and pulls
it out when the dome is closed. Other options:
a pin through matching holes, or a clamp the
plan of one course · red = staple to the course below
Staples hold each new block to the course below until its ring closes. A closed ring wedges itself tight like an arch.
Once the whole dome is closed, all staples come out. Isaac Sim: the dome stands, max drift 4.5 mm during the build.
